title: Require one whole-change review gate after checked implementation
statement: The system shall allow authorized implementation to proceed through checked milestones without mandatory milestone review approval, require one independent whole-change Code Review gate for the complete implementation scope before successful final Verify, and handle corrections and reassessments within that same gate without requiring a permanent attempt history.

what.problem: Per-milestone approvals duplicate the final gate, while removing them without explicit completion and reassessment obligations can conceal defects or permit stale approval.
what.desired_outcome: Implementation progresses in bounded checked work, receives early advice when useful and obtains applicable independent approval of the complete delivered scope before separate final verification.

why.rationale: The user-selected workflow must preserve traceability and independent judgment while assigning each engineering decision one owner and avoiding redundant approval cycles.

stakeholders: Independent reviewers and project decision owners
Maintainers of guidance, validation and recording tools

conditions: During implementation progress, optional advisory assessment, whole-change review, correction and final Verify.

contexts: The project-selected governed workflow and its scoped specialist activities, including portable isolated use where applicable.

how.approach: Apply the explicit ownership and dependency conditions in the criteria; record exact scope, decisions, exceptions and assessment basis without inferring approval from mechanics. Detailed Function, Module, Interface and storage realization belongs to subsequent design.

how_much.scope: The selected requirement-first workflow within one Change and its affected dependencies. No new preliminary proposal gate, per-method approval, mandatory milestone approval, automatic external permission or mandatory SQLite prerequisite. Functional and architectural completeness are deliberately deferred to design; the Feature constraints express workflow conditions, not a completed behavior realization.

acceptance_criteria: A milestone is complete only when its recorded implementation scope and required checks are complete. If another milestone is authorized and its dependencies are satisfied, it may proceed without reviewer assignment, a milestone review ID or a clean-review status.

Failed required checks, missing authority, an unresolved requirement or architectural decision, or a material safety issue blocks affected work. Known in-scope defects must be corrected or explicitly dispositioned under applicable authority before implementation is claimed complete.

An explicitly requested interim code review is advisory: its findings concern the inspected scope and cannot settle the whole-change gate, advance lifecycle approval or become an automatic milestone prerequisite. Material findings remain attributable and require responsible correction or disposition without duplicate dossiers.

Implementation completion supplies the complete delivered scope for independent whole-change assessment against accepted IR/SR, applicable ARs, reviewed System/Architecture Design, delivery intent and current evidence, including cross-milestone interactions and relevant code, tests, configuration, migrations, generated output, skills and documentation.

A changes-requested assessment keeps its actionable findings and basis until explicit disposition or reassessment. Owned corrections and relevant checks receive independent reassessment within the same whole-change gate. The current assessment may replace superseded detail without losing open obligations or falsely retargeting a judgment still relied upon.

Reassessment establishes adequate coverage of the complete current result, inspecting corrections and affected interactions and explicitly determining retained applicability. It need not reread unchanged files or rerun unaffected checks automatically; uncertain impact or broad changes may require broader assessment.

Final Verify requires applicable whole-change approval and current evidence and remains distinct from Code Review. A clean advisory review, passed tests or a single completed milestone cannot substitute. A one-milestone Change has one whole-change gate, not an additional milestone approval.

An implementation defect discovered during Verify returns to implementation and affected independent reassessment before renewed Verify; requirement/design defects return to their authoring and review owners. Evidence-collection failure without changed engineering subjects permits affected verification retry without automatic Code Review restart. New contradictory evidence requires approval-applicability assessment.

Operational bookkeeping, evidence retries and edits shown to have no material effect on assessed behavior, instructions, obligations or support can retain an approved whole-change Review with an explicit applicability disposition, without another Review attempt. Material changes require independent reassessment of affected subjects and interactions; uncertain impact remains unresolved until assessed. Route coordinates recorded handoffs but does not create reviewer judgments or infer harmlessness from edit size or file type.

An isolated request for one implementation slice ends at that authorized scope. Removal of milestone review gates grants no additional execution, merge, publication or other external-action authority.
assumptions: Existing governance and recording remain available until explicit coordinated adoption; target skill and CLI support is not assumed installed.
constraints: Draft authoring and structural validation do not establish independent review approval or activate the new workflow.

sources.basis: User-selected requirement-first workflow and one mandatory whole-change Code Review gate. Proposed requirement analysis only; existing product contracts remain active until coordinated adoption. No new Function, AR, implementation or approval is inferred.
Draft integrated design from the accepted requirement-first basis. This defines target responsibility and cooperation, not installed capability, design approval, runtime evidence or SQLite adoption.

Proposed allocation composition: Work context exposes checks, blockers and scope while coordination permits only authorized eligible continuation. This is a design argument, not executed satisfaction evidence.

Proposed allocation composition: Assurance preserves full-scope attempts and applicability; coordination distinguishes advice, the whole-change gate, correction ownership and final Verify. This is a design argument, not executed satisfaction evidence.

User-directed refinement of review applicability after subsequent edits: preserve original judgments, allow justified harmless-change continuation and independently reassess material effects. Author-assessed design/requirement refinement only; no runtime adoption or independent approval is claimed.
User-selected current handoff and selective retention refinement. Reuse existing identity and responsibility; no runtime adoption or independent approval is asserted.
